reference.title: Config (bacnet-ScConfiguration)
reference.shortdesc: This component configures secure connect timings.

section.p: To access these properties, expand BacnetNetworkBacnet CommNetwork, then expand either ScHubPort or ScPort, expand Link and double-click Config.

property.propdesc: Specifies the maximum BVLC (BACnet Virtual Link Control) message size that can be received and processed by the node in bytes.

Specifies the maximum NPDU (Network Protocol Data Unit message size that can be handled by the node's network entity in bytes. This value must be less than the Node Max Bvlc Length. The difference determines the maximum size of BVLC destination and data options.

property.propvalue: hours minutes seconds (defaults to two seconds)
property.propdesc:
Defines the shortest amount of time to wait following a failure before attempting the connection again.
A second consecutive primary connection failure waits an amount of time that is double the minimum. A third failure waits four times the minimum, a fourth eight times the minimum, etc. up to the Maximum Reconnect Time.
Once it reaches the maximum, which defaults to 10 minutes, the connection attempts to reconnect every maximum amount of time forever.

property.propvalue: hours minutes seconds (defaults to two minutes)
property.propdesc: Defines the longest amount of time to wait following a connection failure before attempting to connect again.

property.propvalue: hours minutes seconds (defaults to ten seconds)
property.propdesc: Defines how long a connection waits for an initial response message before concluding that the attempt failed.

property.propvalue: hours minutes seconds (defaults to ten seconds)
property.propdesc: Defines how long a node waits for a response message while disconnecting.

property.propvalue: hours minutes seconds (defaults to ten seconds)
property.propdesc: Defines how long a connection waits without success to establish a web socket connection before concluding that the attempt failed.

property.propvalue: hours minutes seconds (defaults to five minutes)
property.propdesc: Defines how long an initiating hub or direct connection waits without receiving any messages before sending a heartbeat request message. If no messages are received after another timeout period, the connection will be disconnected.

property.propvalue: hours minutes seconds (defaults to eight minutes)
property.propdesc: Similar to Initiating Heartbeat Timeout except that it applies to accepting hub and direct connections. The value of this timeout is typically longer than the Initiating Heartbeat Timeout so that the initiating connections usually send heartbeat request messages.

Whenever this property or Initiating Heartbeat Timeout is changed, the Accepting Heartbeat Timeout is updated based on the multiplier. For example, if the multiplier is 1.5 and Initiating Heartbeat Timeout is changed to 6 minutes, the Accepting Heartbeat Timeout would be set to 9 minutes. To keep the Accepting Heartbeat Timeout from being updated, the multiplier can be set to zero. This property was added in to accommodate the final version of the BACnet Network Port object that has only one heartbeat timeout property.
